name: nimony
description: Language support for Nimony (the NIF-based Nim successor), powered by the aowllsp language server.

commands.title: Nimony: Clear Compile Cache & Restart Server

nimony.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `aowllsp` language server binary. Empty = look for `aowllsp` in the extension's own directory, then on `PATH`.

nimony.nimonyPath.description: Path to the `nimony` compiler binary. Empty = the server uses `NIMONY_EXE`, then `nimony` from PATH.

nimony.aowllensPath.description: Optional path to `aowllens` (NIF artifact reader) — enables symbols, completion, semantic tokens, inlay hints, call/type hierarchy. Empty = disabled.

nimony.aowlsuggestPath.description: Optional path to `aowlsuggest` (recovering parser). Enables syntax diagnostics and quick-fix code actions. Empty = disabled.

nimony.aowlfmtPath.description: Optional path to `aowlfmt` (verified layout formatter). Enables document/range formatting. Empty = disabled.

nimony.extraPaths.description: Additional module search paths passed to the Nimony compiler via the language server.

nimony.daemonPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to a `nimsem serve` binary. When set, definition / references / workspace-symbol are resolved by the persistent warm daemon (exact cross-module overload resolution, no per-query `nimony check`), falling back to the built-in idetools path on any miss. Empty = disabled.

nimony.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VSCode and the Nimony language server.
